thread:
elaine park: Quick escalation — Senior ML Infra candidate (US remote) asking for a provisional compband uplift plus split sign-on and immediate benefits. Need comp + finance + benefits policy alignment.

elaine park: Offer snapshot:
```
Base: USD 155,000
Sign-on: USD 20,000 (request: 50% on first payroll, 50% after 6 months)
Requested provisional uplift: Band 4B -> 4C for 6 months
Requested start: 2026-07-06 (payroll cutoff 07/15)
Work location: US-remote (CA resident)
```

samir shah: Couple of clarifying Qs: is candidate onboarded as W-2 employee to Redwood US Inc? Any relocation/relocation stipend?

elaine park: Yes W-2. No relocation. Manager says retention risk if we can't get benefits day 1 and wants provisional uplift while comp buys more time for market review.

claire nguyen: Benefits policy note — medical plan waiting periods vary by state; we can request a benefits enrollment exception to backdate coverage to start date if enrollment completed before payroll cutoff, but needs Benefits Ops signoff. For equity/compband provisional increases we need comp-committee + finance to confirm GL coding and withholding approach for split sign-on.

julian ross: Finance: split sign-on doable but we need to decide whether the first tranche is grossed up or treated as taxable withholding as normal. Also need to confirm employer payroll taxes for CA and any state SDI implications.

people-ops-bot: Routing to comp-committee: "Provisional Band Uplift + Sign-on Split". Please attach manager justification, rollback plan, and proposed retention clause.

samir shah: Manager justification uploaded: https://redwood.share/people-ops/docs/offer-4129876543-mgr-just (private). Manager agrees to a 6-month review and rollback if retention milestones not hit.

claire nguyen: Benefits action — I'll ask Benefits Ops for exception. If payroll runs 07/15, we can backdate coverage to 07/06 provided enrollment forms are signed and benefits team approves exception. Might need to coordinate dependent enrollments separately.

julian ross: I'll draft the tax note: options are (A) pay first tranche gross and candidate handles withholding, (B) gross-up so candidate receives a net amount, or (C) hold part until next payroll and pay as catch-up. Each has different GL/tax treatment. Need comp committee guidance on preferred option.

samir shah: Legal/offer language: if comp uplift is provisional we need explicit rollback language and candidate acknowledgement. Will route to legal after comp decision.

elaine park: Candidate asked for decision by COB Wednesday. Can comp-committee triage on Tuesday?

people-ops-bot: Actions logged: [Elaine] attach 1-pager + retention metrics, [Julian] tax withholding options, [Claire] benefits exception request, [Comp-Committee] decision requested by 2026-07-07. :calendar:
